subject: Your hands. Two inks. No undo.
preheader: A printmaking evening at Offcut. Make ten prints, keep the happy accidents.

attrs.alt: A cobalt ink-covered brayer lies diagonally over a blue circle and a vermilion block printed on torn cream paper.

content.text: Your hands. Two inks. Ten prints.
